procedure_name: Registered Vehicle Scrappage Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
summary: Environment-friendly scrappage of end-of-life vehicles (15+ years) granting motor tax rebates on new car purchase.
estimated_total_cost: Scrap metal value paid to owner + up to 25% road tax rebate

steps.title: Identify authorized RVSF facility
steps.description: Select government-registered authorized vehicle scrap center on national portal.

steps.title: Handover vehicle with original documents
steps.description: Provide vehicle along with original RC, insurance, and owner identity proofs.

steps.title: Physical inspection & valuation
steps.description: Scrappage center weighs vehicle and evaluates scrap metal and component salvage value.

steps.title: Scientific dismantling and destruction
steps.description: Vehicle undergoes eco-friendly fluid draining, hazardous material depollution, and chassis shredding.

steps.title: Issuance of Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
steps.description: Owner receives digital Certificate of Deposit conferring up to 25% concession on new vehicle road tax.
